title: Now Playing on Spotify
description: What's playing on your Spotify right now. The card hides when nothing plays.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: From your app at developer.spotify.com (Dashboard → your app → Settings). The module's README shows how to make one.

auth_response.title: Login Address
auth_response.description: After logging in through the address on the card, paste the address your browser landed on (http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback?code=…) here and save.

show_header.title: Show Header
show_header.description: Show or hide the module's title.

show_cover.title: Show Cover
show_cover.description: The album cover beside the track.

cover_style.title: Cover
cover_style.description: Black and white is calmer through the glass.

show_progress.title: Show Progress
show_progress.description: A bar with how far into the track it is.

show_album.title: Show Album
show_album.description: The album's name under the artist.

show_playlist.title: Show Playlist
show_playlist.description: The playlist it plays from (or Liked Songs), when it plays from one.

show_device.title: Show Device
show_device.description: Where it plays, e.g. a speaker or a phone.

interval.title: Update Interval (Seconds)
interval.description: How often to ask Spotify what's playing.
